annotations.text:
Why the shipped cover reads as off

It wasn't your eye. The connector lines were hardcoded from the mockup while the tiles moved, so every endpoint missed its tile centre by 5-8px. The wires looked like they joined the tiles without ever touching them.

All three directions here compute the connectors from the real centres, so they actually land.

What the marks now mean

The old cover drew 8 of your 13 libraries. These draw one mark per PROJECT - browser, graph, shield, ticket, phone, calendar, cycle, terminal - so the cover is about the eight things you built, not the packages they import.

Prominence follows the content order: Personal Website is featured, so it takes the ink tile.

Constellation keeps what you already picked, fixed and re-based on projects. Safest.

Index is the most museum-native - a checklist of what's in the room. Quietest, and it reads at any size.

Range is the only one that argues something: C to Android is unusual spread. Most memorable, least conventional.

Say which and I'll build it in.
